pairs.subject: silver-medalist-rediscovery
pairs.evidence: app/features/library/jobs/jobsRediscoveryFeedLogic.ts:251 The feed's reach-out action ultimately uses a first-contact draft without prior-process facts, preventing the required rediscovery disclosure.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/rediscovery-rank.ts:41 The boost is capped, but depends only on stage; older assessments receive the same boost as recent ones, contrary to the ageing rule.
pipeline/jobfit/automation.py:1234 Tracing postReachOut through the outreach route and automation runner reaches this generic draft; no prior role, date, stage or outcome is supplied.
app/_lib/rediscovery-alert-store.ts:133 Current-role scoring and the shared numeric floor exist, but persisted matches do not record which floor value admitted them, as the standard requires.
app/_lib/rediscovery-alert-store.ts:466 Grants union and anonymisation dominates, but a missing-table consent lookup returns no suppressions instead of failing closed and logging the refusal.
app/_lib/rediscover.ts:114 Active and hired people in another role can qualify as elsewhere priors, although the standard excludes both populations.

app/_lib/rediscovery-relevance.ts:18 The feed checks publication and target-role pipeline presence, alongside a separate consent gate, but does not reassess current fit or exclude activity and hires elsewhere.

pairs.subject: silver-medalist-rediscovery
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/rediscover.ts:326 The alerts API's live projection checks pipeline presence only for the target role, allowing people active or hired elsewhere to remain visible.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/rediscover.ts:91 The alerts sweep uses bounded stage-based boosts without any prior-assessment age input, so the required ageing is absent.
app/api/rediscovery/alerts/route.ts:84 These routes return rankings, reasoning, registry data and alerts; they do not compose or send a candidate's first re-approach message.
app/_lib/rediscovery-alert-store.ts:134 The sweep applies the shared floor before boosting, but its persisted alert values omit the admission floor required for historical explanation.

app/_lib/outreach-state-store.ts:135 The alerts gate aggregates opt-outs across candidate entries, but this missing-table lookup exception returns an empty opt-out set instead of withholding candidates.
app/_lib/rediscover.ts:106 Any other-role rejection qualifies without checking that assessment occurred, so pre-assessment screen-outs are not structurally excluded.
app/_lib/rediscover.ts:324 The live read filters stored alerts by role, pipeline presence and consent, but does not recompute fit against an edited brief or enforce a read-time age horizon.
